paragraphlinks-desc: Short description of the ParagraphLinks extension, shown on Special:Version
paragraphlinks-config-enabled: Description of the ParagraphLinksEnabled configuration variable, shown in configuration documentation
paragraphlinks-config-namespaces: Description of the ParagraphLinksNamespaces configuration variable, shown in configuration documentation
paragraphlinks-copy-link: Tooltip text used as the aria-label and title attribute of the 🔗 icon that appears on hover next to each section heading. Should be a short imperative phrase.
paragraphlinks-copied: Success notification shown to the user after the section link URL has been successfully copied to the clipboard
paragraphlinks-copy-failed: Error notification shown to the user when the clipboard copy operation fails
